accepted_internal_statements.statement: For N>=1000,L=6M,M>=2, sources formed from M six-gate identity relators followed by arbitrary relabeling/rotation and at most b adjacent Hurwitz moves have a deterministic one-query six-window distinguisher against matched Q_k(U) of advantage>=7/10 whenever H=M-1-2b-k>=M/2; scan cost O(L) label operations. Exact finite reference bound is min(1,(L-5)p6(id)^2/(H*p12(id))).

Frozen C1 is rejected by an aligned-window test; at a=ceil(B/2) and B-2s-k>=a its reference false acceptance is <=min(1,N!*binom(B,a)*q^(-a)); declared N=lambda^2,B=lambda^6,s=floor(B/10),k=lambda schedule has exp(-Omega(lambda^6 log lambda)) deficit.

Frozen C2 always has noisy word support<=h=m+1+2k. For N>=2m,h<=N, matched reference false acceptance<=min(1,binom(N,h)*binom(h,2)^(2m)/D),D=(N)_(2m)*(2m)!/(4^m*m!). On N=lambda^6,m=lambda,k=floor(sqrt(lambda)), it is<=lambda^(-lambda) for lambda>=1024, regardless of Hurwitz step count.

Exact local-observable bias transfer through Q_k for k<=L-s with factor alpha_s/(2*3^s), explicitly charged rational arithmetic and public polynomial evaluator/value-size assumptions for efficient fixed-s corollary. V1/v2 overbroad computational clauses remain superseded.
